items.title: 21.4 Halogenoalkanes ke reactions ki misalein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 21.4 with Quick Check 21.3, printed pages 79-81.

blocks.text: Halogenoalkane aabi (aqueous) sodium hydroxide se react kar ke, halaat (conditions) ke mutabiq, substitution aur elimination dono products deta hai. Hydroxide ion (OH⁻) achha nucleophile bhi hai aur achha base bhi. Jab yeh nucleophile ban kar hamla karta hai to halogen ki jagah le leta hai aur substitution product, alcohol, banta hai. Jab yeh base ka kaam karta hai to β-hydrogen aur halogen dono ko hata deta hai aur elimination product, alkene, banti hai. Reaction zyada temperature par reflux (bhaap ko thanda kar ke wapas flask mein girane) ke saath kiya jata hai taake urne wale (volatile) products zaya na hon. Bromoethane aabi sodium hydroxide se ethanol bhi deta hai aur ethene bhi.

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala bromoethane + NaOH, teer ke oopar 'aqueous' (aabi), se khuli banawat wala ethanol + NaBr.
blocks.caption: Substitution reaction: bromoethane aur aabi sodium hydroxide (kitab ke PDF safha 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala bromoethane + NaOH, teer ke oopar 'alcohol', se khuli banawat wali ethene + HOH + NaBr.
blocks.caption: Elimination reaction: bromoethane aur alcohol mein sodium hydroxide (kitab ke PDF safha 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: paani (aqueous) mein OH⁻ zyada tar nucleophile ban kar alcohol deta hai; alcohol (ethanol) mein OH⁻ zyada tar base ban kar alkene deta hai.
ii. Halogenoalkanes ke KCN se reactions

Cyanide ion (CN⁻) taqatwar nucleophile hai lekin kamzor base, is liye yeh halogenoalkanes se substitution product, yani nitrile, deta hai. Aam taur par halogenoalkane ko potassium cyanide ke ethanol wale mehlool (ethanolic solution) ke saath reflux par garam kiya jata hai. Bromoethane potassium cyanide se react kar ke propanenitrile deta hai; is mein ek carbon zyada ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala bromoethane + K+ -C(teen bond)N, teer ke oopar 'alcohol', se khuli banawat wala propanenitrile, H3C-CH2-C(teen bond)N, + KBr.
blocks.caption: Bromoethane aur potassium cyanide (kitab ke PDF safha 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: iii. Halogenoalkanes ke Ammonia se reactions

Ammonia achha nucleophile hai aur halogenoalkanes se aasani se react karti hai. Agar halogenoalkane aur ammonia ki miqdar ehtiyat se qabu mein rakhi jaye to mukhtalif qism ke amines banaye ja sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Ammonia, N par lone pair, aur N se C2H5-Br ke carbon ki taraf mura teer; C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mura teer. Natija ethylamine, H2N-C2H5, + HBr (hydrogen bromide).
blocks.caption: Ammonia aur bromoethane (kitab ke PDF safha 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ethanamine khud bhi nucleophile hai, is liye yeh ammonia se muqabla kar ke alkyl halide se react karti hai aur diethyl amine (N-ethylethanamine) banti hai.

blocks.alt: Ethanamine (N par C2H5, do H aur lone pair) se C2H5-Br ke carbon ki taraf aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mure teer; natija N-ethylethanamine + HBr.
blocks.caption: Ethanamine aur bromoethane (kitab ke PDF safha 83 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: N-ethylethanamine bhi nucleophile ka kaam karti hai aur ek aur bromoethane molecule par hamla karti hai; is se N,N-diethylethanamine aur hydrogen bromide bante hain.

blocks.alt: N-ethylethanamine (N par do C2H5, aik H aur lone pair) se C2H5-Br ke carbon ki taraf aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mure teer; natija N,N-diethylethanamine + HBr.
blocks.caption: N-ethylethanamine aur bromoethane (kitab ke PDF safha 83 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Agar bromoethane bohat zyada miqdar (large excess) mein ho to reaction aage chal kar aakhir mein quaternary ammonium salt (namak) deta hai.

blocks.alt: N,N-diethylethanamine (N par teen C2H5 aur lone pair) se C2H5-Br ke carbon ki taraf aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mure teer; natija quaternary namak (salt): chaar C2H5 wala N, chaukor bracket mein musbat charge ke saath, aur bracket ke bahar Br-.
blocks.caption: N,N-diethylethanamine aur bromoethane (kitab ke PDF safha 83 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne aakhri product mein Br⁻ ko bhi musbat ion ke bracket ke andar chhapa hai aur naam 'N,N,N-triethylethanaminebromide' likha hai. Sahi yeh hai: musbat ion [(C₂H₅)₄N]⁺ bracket ke andar aur Br⁻ bracket ke bahar; naam N,N,N-triethylethanaminium bromide (yani tetraethylammonium bromide).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har qadam mein N ka lone pair (akela electron jora) C₂H₅–Br ke carbon par hamla karta hai aur Br nikal jata hai. Har qadam ke baad N par ek aur C₂H₅ group lag jata hai: NH₃ → C₂H₅NH₂ → (C₂H₅)₂NH → (C₂H₅)₃N → (C₂H₅)₄N⁺Br⁻.
iv. Halogenoalkanes ke aabi Silver Nitrate se reactions

Yeh reaction paani aur ethanol ke mixture mein kiya jata hai; ethanol halogenoalkane ko ghulne (dissolve hone) mein madad deta hai. Paani nucleophile ka kaam kar ke halogenoalkane se react karta hai aur halide ion ki jagah le leta hai.

Nikalne wala halide ion phir silver nitrate se react kar ke precipitate (tah mein baithne wala thos) deta hai, jis ka rang (colour) batata hai ke kaun sa halide ion maujood tha. Is tarah yeh reaction halogenoalkane mein halide ion ki pehchan mein madad deta hai.

blocks.alt: Aabi ethanol wale silver nitrate ki teen test tubes: chloroalkane se AgCl ka safaid (white) precipitate bohat dheere, bromoalkane se AgBr ka cream yellow precipitate tez, aur iodoalkane se AgI ka bright yellow precipitate sab se tez. Har tube ke neeche Ag+ + Cl- -> AgCl, Ag+ + Br- -> AgBr, Ag+ + I- -> AgI.
blocks.caption: Silver nitrate se halogen ki pehchan (is reaction ke liye asal khaaka, kitab ki figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Precipitate ka rang halogen batata hai, aur jis raftaar se woh nazar aata hai woh halogenoalkane ki reactivity dikhati hai: iodoalkane sab se jaldi, bromoalkane us ke baad, aur chloroalkane bohat dheere.

blocks.text: Is reaction mein silver halides kitni jaldi bante hain, yeh dekh kar halides ki reactivity ka andaza hota hai. Precipitate jitni jaldi aaye, halogenoalkane utna zyada reactive hai. Iodoalkane bromoalkane se bohat jaldi precipitate deta hai, jab ke chloroalkane bohat dheere react karta hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Halogenoalkanes ko organic compounds ki bohat reactive qism kyun samjha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: C – X bond polar hai, is liye carbon electrophilic (δ+) hai aur nucleophiles ka nishana banta hai; halide ion achha leaving group hai; aur C – Cl, C – Br, C – I bonds nisbatan kamzor hain. Bases HX hata kar alkenes bhi bana sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Equation mukammal karein: C₂H₅Br + CH₃COONa →
blocks.explanation: C₂H₅Br + CH₃COONa → CH₃COOC₂H₅ (ethyl ethanoate) + NaBr. Ethanoate ion (CH₃COO⁻) nucleophile ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Ethane ko ethanol aur ethene mein kaise badlenge?
blocks.explanation: Pehle roshni mein ethane + Cl₂ → chloroethane + HCl. Phir chloroethane ko aabi NaOH ke saath garam karein to ethanol; ethanol (alcohol) mein NaOH ke saath garam karein to ethene.

blocks.prompt: d) Bromopropane ka KCN se reaction likhein. Yeh substitution hai ya elimination? Asal product ka naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂CH₂Br + KCN → CH₃CH₂CH₂CN + KBr (ethanol mein, reflux). Yeh nucleophilic substitution hai; asal product butanenitrile hai.

items: Aabi NaOH: alcohol (substitution); alcohol mein NaOH: alkene (elimination).
Ethanol mein KCN: nitrile (ek carbon zyada). NH₃: amines, aakhir mein quaternary ammonium salt.
AgNO₃ (paani + ethanol): AgCl safaid, AgBr cream yellow, AgI chamakdar peela; iodoalkane sab se tez, chloroalkane sab se dheere.
